summaryZh: Zheng 实验室研究脑和脊髓轴突为何在损伤后无法再生。团队使用基因修饰小鼠解析相关机制，以指导脊髓损伤、白质卒中和神经退行性疾病治疗。
researchQuestions: 脑和脊髓中的轴突为何在损伤后无法再生？

evidence.quote: We are scientists in the Department of Neurosciences at UC San Diego studying why axons in the brain and spinal cord fail to regenerate after injury. Using genetically modified mice, we investigate the underlying mechanisms to help guide treatments for spinal cord injury, white matter stroke, and neurodegenerative diseases.
